system.name: OFFSIDE
system.one_liner: Benchmark for unlearning misinformation in multimodal LLMs: 15.68K records on 80 football players, four test sets and four unlearning settings.

content.variant_note: four pastel setting cards around a central logo badge, each one a real record: image tile plus question, ground-truth and answer rows
content.argues: OFFSIDE tests rumor unlearning in four real-world settings: complete, fine-grained, corrective relearning and unimodal.
content.subject: Four unlearning settings of one benchmark, each shown by a footballer photo and a question with ground-truth and answer rows.

layout.arrangement_note: Four borderless tinted cards in a two-by-two grid, each with a coloured header strip (setting title and small icons), three aligned rows Q, GT and A, and an image tile. Tile and header strip swap sides so the layout mirrors: photo at the left in the left column and at the right in the right column, header on top in the upper row and below the rows in the lower row. A round OFFSIDE football badge overlaps the inner corners of the grid; a small legend sits under the lower-left card.

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each evaluation setting the same record card, an image tile plus Q, GT and A rows, in its own pastel, and let colour inside the answer text carry the verdict, so settings compare at a glance without ticks or arrows. A logo badge at the centre of the grid ties the cards together.
lessons.suits: Benchmark papers with a few evaluation settings, each of which can be shown by one concrete question-answer record.

evidence: Texts in red represent the target rumor, while those in green indicate successful forgetting or relearning.
OFFSIDE is a comprehensive benchmark for MLLMs MU, featuring four real-world settings designed to address the removal of various rumors.
the Corrective Relearning setting, which examines whether previously unlearned rumors can be successfully recovered after post-training

summary: OFFSIDE is a benchmark for unlearning misinformation in multimodal large language models, built around 80 football players. Figure 1 shows its four evaluation settings as tinted cards in a two-by-two grid around a round OFFSIDE badge with a referee pictogram: Complete Unlearning, Fine-grained Unlearning, Corrective Relearning and Unimodal Unlearning. Each card is a record: a footballer photo, or an empty-set tile when the question is text-only, beside three rows, Q for the question, GT for the ground truth and A for the model's answer. Red values mark the target rumor and green values mark successful forgetting or relearning. Small icons in the headers, keyed in a legend, tell shared from private information.
summary_zh: OFFSIDE 是评测多模态大模型遗忘谣言的基准。图1把四种设置（完全遗忘、细粒度遗忘、纠正性重学、单模态遗忘）画成2×2彩色卡片，围绕中央裁判足球徽标；每张卡有球员照片和Q、GT、A三行，红字为目标谣言，绿字为遗忘或重学成功。
notes: Prior order (contribution-mosaic first) reversed so that scope-overview example-gallery leads, since each card is a real sample of one setting the benchmark covers. The meaning of the Q, GT, A letters and of which header icons each card carries is not spelled out in the figure or the quoted text. The caption says green marks successful forgetting or relearning, so green Chelsea in both GT and A of the Corrective Relearning card is read as recovered knowledge.
